! Game text
| Plays on table. During your turn, opponent loses 2 Force each time they move away from a location you occupy. At end of opponent's turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and a system), and your opponent deployed a card with ability this turn and {{Errata hl|1=did not battle}}, {{Errata hl|1=randomly select a card from your Lost Pile and then place it here or take it into hand}}. During your move phase, {{Errata hl|1=you may relocate X characters, ships, and vehicles for free to locations the opponent occupies}}, where X = the number of cards stacked here. || Plays on table. If opponent moves from a location you occupy during your turn, they lose 2 Force. At end of opponent’s turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and system) and opponent deployed a card with ability and {{Errata hl|1=did not initiate a battle}}, you {{Errata hl|1=may retrieve 1 Force}}.
|}
